name: ai-mascot
description: A live SVG mascot that shows what your assistant is doing: idle breathes, floats and blinks; listening leans in with wide eyes; thinking tilts its head while a companion dot orbits around it, passing behind and in front of the body; writing looks down as the dot draws a line under it; done squints happily and the dot becomes a sparkle; error shakes once with worried brows. The eyes follow the pointer on a damped spring, every status change blends from the pose currently on screen over 420 ms, it self-plays through all states when status is unset, freezes into clean static poses under prefers-reduced-motion and can announce state changes through a polite live region.
